diagnostic_note.problem_description: Over/Under arrays were being identified in odds data but flattened fields were not appearing in output. Root cause: Field name conflict between 'match_status' from Over/Under array and existing match data structure.
diagnostic_note.solution_applied: Changed Over/Under array[5] field from 'match_status' to 'overunder_match_status' to prevent field conflicts during extraction.
diagnostic_note.general_application: For future field extraction issues: 1) Verify field name uniqueness to prevent conflicts, 2) Check that array identification AND field assignment are both working, 3) Look for field processing order issues that might cause overwrites, 4) Test extraction logic with actual data arrays.
diagnostic_note.technical_details: Over/Under flattening code was functional but 'match_status' field assignment was being overwritten by existing match data processing. Fix ensures unique field names for all flattened array elements.
